propositions: The structural guard test test_no_search_issues_call_relies_on_the_default_page_size became vacuous after commit 465d split DC transport into capability mixins and moved all search_issues calls from transport.py to _base.py and _issues.py without updating the test's hardcoded scan path
The guard's AST scan is hardcoded to _TRANSPORT_SRC pointing only to transport.py, so it now finds zero search_issues call nodes and passes unconditionally instead of policing the seam

The guard must be repaired by widening its scan scope from transport.py to the entire adapters/jira_datacenter/ directory, adding a non-vacuity assertion to prevent future silent disarming, and adding a teeth test proving detection of uncapped calls in non-transport modules
Four other single-file AST structural guards in the test suite were also emptied by module relocations and became vacuous via the same mechanism
